Announcements
[$500 coupon] Participant recruitment for an HKU intervention study 招攬40歲以上合資格人士參與健康指導及可穿戴裝置介入研究-可獲得[500超市禮券]  - Department of Sports Science and Physical Education
From: Hanwen Zhang
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ham.zhang@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
參加者招募：健康指導及可穿戴裝置介入研究
香港大學（港大）Youngwon Kim教授正與香港中文大學（中大）楊懌健教授合作，招募中央肥胖的成年人士參與研究。本研究旨在探討可穿戴裝置功能及健康指導對活動行為與心臟代謝風險因素的影響。
參與研究包括甚麼？
前往實驗室三次。每次到訪包括約1小時的評估，例如收集人口統計資料、量度血壓、抽取血液樣本及填寫問卷。
在指定研究期間連續24小時佩戴研究級可穿戴裝置。
接受其中一種介入方案：僅使用Fitbit可穿戴裝置功能，或使用相同功能並在一年內接受至少22節健康指導課程。
在約20個月內完成整個研究方案。
參與研究可能帶來甚麼益處？
了解心臟代謝疾病，並提供建議的生活方式調整。
獲得有助了解個人健康及體適能狀況的報告，包括Fitbit數據及血脂分析。
完成整個研究方案後，可獲港幣500元超市禮券。
哪些人士可能符合參加資格？
如您符合以下全部條件，便可能具備參加資格：
東亞裔，年齡為40歲或以上。
腰圍達90厘米或以上（男性），或80厘米或以上（女性）。
現時的體能活動量未達世界衞生組織建議水平。
使用智能手機。
能以中文或英文溝通。
能夠進行一般日常生活活動。
現時並未參與其他改變生活方式的研究或運動計劃。
如何登記或查詢更多資料？
如您有興趣參加，請掃描下方的登記二維碼，或聯絡研究團隊。
掃描二維碼登記
電話／
WhatsApp
：
52447300
電郵：
pastudy@hku.hk
實驗室地址：
香港薄扶林沙宣道5號賽馬會跨學科研究大樓3樓305室運動生理學實驗室。
抽血注意事項：
抽血前須禁食8小時，即不可進食或飲用任何飲品，包括茶、咖啡及酒精；期間可以飲用清水。
如有查詢，請透過上述聯絡方法與Youngwon Kim教授及港大研究團隊聯絡。歡迎您將此招募資料轉發予可能符合參加資格的人士。
Participant Recruitment: Intervention Study on Health Coaching and Wearable Devices
Professor Youngwon Kim at The University of Hong Kong (HKU), in collaboration with Professor Yijian Yang at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), is recruiting adults with central obesity. The study will examine how wearable-device functions and health coaching affect movement behaviours and cardiometabolic risk factors.
What does participation involve?
Attend three laboratory visits. Each visit includes an approximately 1-hour assessment, such as collecting demographic information, measuring blood pressure, drawing blood, and administering questionnaires.
Wear a research-grade wearable device continuously for 24 hours during designated study periods.
Receive one of two interventions: Fitbit-based wearable functions alone, or the same wearable functions combined with at least 22 health-coaching sessions delivered over 1 year.
Complete the full study protocol over approximately 20 months.
What are the potential benefits?
Learn about cardiometabolic diseases and recommended lifestyle changes.
Receive reports that may help you understand your health and fitness status, including Fitbit data and a lipid profile.
Receive an HK$500 supermarket coupon after completing the full study protocol.
Who may be eligible?
You may be eligible if you meet all the following criteria:
Are East Asian and aged 40 years or above.
Have a waist circumference of at least 90 cm (men) or at least 80 cm (women).
Do not currently meet the World Health Organization-recommended levels of physical activity.
Use a smartphone.
Can communicate in Chinese or English.
Can perform usual activities of daily living.
Are not currently participating in another lifestyle-change research study or exercise programme.
How can I register or obtain more information?
If you are interested, please scan the registration QR code below or contact the research team.
Scan to register
Phone/WhatsApp:
52447300
E-mail:
pastudy@hku.hk
Laboratory address:
Exercise Physiology Lab (Room 305), 3/F, Jockey Club Building for Interdisciplinary Research, 5 Sassoon Road, Pokfulam, Hong Kong.
Important note for blood collection:
An 8-hour fast is required before the phlebotomy session. This means no food or drinks, including tea, coffee and alcohol. Water may be consumed freely.
For enquiries, please contact Professor Youngwon Kim and the HKU research team using the details above.You are welcome to share this invitation with people who may meet the eligibility criteria.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Announcements
[Recruiting Older Adult Caregivers] Effects of mindfulness-based intervention on the microbiome of older adult with chronic stress: A randomised controlled trial (Earn up to $300 supermarket vouchers ! )  【誠招年長照顧者】靜觀課程對有慢性壓力的長者的微生物群成效研究 (完成最高獲$300現金券) - SPHPC
From: Donald Liu
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
donaldliu@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
靜觀課程對有慢性壓力的長者的微生物群成效研究: 隨機對照試驗
Effects of mindfulness-based training on the microbiome of older adults with chronic stress: A randomised controlled trial
現正誠邀合資格人士報名參加
We are now recruiting participants to join our programme.
賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院 現誠邀60歲以上人士參加一項靜觀課程研究
研究將會探討靜觀課程對有慢性壓力的長者的微生物群的影響。
很多長者受慢性壓力困擾，如未能適當處理壓力，對他們的心理及生理皆有嚴重影響。研究發現慢性壓力會破壞腸道微生物群的平衡。靜觀證實可有效改善心理健康，卻甚少研究探究靜觀課程如何改善參與者的微生物群。這項研究將在社區招募138名年滿60歲人士，邀請他們參與為長者而設的靜觀課程與健康教育控制課程，比較兩者於改善壓力、負面情緒及腸道微生物的成效。
參加者將會被隨機分派入兩組其中一組：
a) 靜觀練習組：
分派入本組的參加者將接受為期八周，每週一次，每次大約一小時三十分鐘的靜觀課程。每堂靜課程將會錄音，以作審視課程的保真度。
b) 健康教育組：
分派入本組的參加者會接受為期八周，每週一次，每次大約一小時三十分鐘的健康教育課程，課程內容包括營養，運動，維持生活習慣。每堂靜課程將會錄音，以作審視課程的保真度。
招募對象:
i) 年齡60歲以上;
ii) 能聽講廣東話;
iii) 需要持續照顧有長期病患的親屬;
iv) 照顧者負荷指數達 7分或以上;
v)沒有經醫生診斷有精神病患或認知問題;
vi) 沒有嚴重的身體或精神問題;
vi)不是正接受心理治療;
vii) 兩年內沒有參加過正規的靜觀課程;
viii) 被照顧親屬並非剛離世;
ix) 三個月內沒有使用抗生素或益生菌
課堂詳情
時間：10月尾開始 星期三或四的 上午
地點：沙田瀝源健康院 - 本活動共8節, 每週1次, 每次1.5小時
兩組參加者均須在課程開始前、結束後，及結束後3個月填寫共次3問卷調查及提供3次糞便樣本。
*費用全免*
參與是次研究不需繳付任何費用。
每次提供樣本及填寫問卷將會獲得價值$100 的現金卷，最高可獲300元現金卷。
歡迎將以上資訊廣傳給親朋好友。
如需了解更多本研究資訊或查詢，請聯絡：
廖先生/魏先生 (研究助理)
電話：2252-8463  Whatsapp: 5264 6865
如有興趣參與研究，請使用以下連結報名。
報名：https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_8cu06nvBsZqwVBY

Calling all CUHK students Join COP31 as a Student Delegate through self-funded participation and gain first-hand insights into global climate action
Successful candidates will attend COP31 for at least four days, with guidance from Professor Amos Tai of the Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences and Professor Yuan Xu of the Department of Geography and Resource Management. Participants will have the chance to connect with global sustainability experts, gain exposure to international climate negotiations, and explore emerging solutions to climate challenges
COP31 dates: 9–20 November 2026
Location: Antalya, Türkiye
ℹ Details and Registration:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13736695
Registration Deadline: 18 September 2026
Should you have any questions, please contact the Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development Office (
srsdo@cuhk.edu.hk
).
各位中大同學注意 歡迎報名成為 COP31中大學生代表，以自費形式參與會議，親身了解全球氣候議題
獲選的同學將有機會參與至少四天的會議，在地球與環境科學系戴沛權教授及地理與資源管理學系徐袁教授的指導下，與全球可持續發展專家交流，了解國際氣候談判，並探索應對氣候挑戰的方案

地點：土耳其安塔利亞

( Receive up to HK$400 Allowance!) Recruiting young adults (aged 18–24)for online sleep and mental health intervention with individualized support 💫💫~誠邀18至24歲青年😼😼參加網上睡眠及心理健康課程，仲有個人化的指導🗣（最高可獲得$400💰津貼！） ~ - Department of Psychiatry
From: Winifred Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
sleepresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學精神科學系正進行一項研究，旨在評估手機應用程式的認知行為治療結合晝夜節律改善大學生的睡眠及情緒。現招募年齡介乎18歲至24歲在學青年研究。詳情如下:
我們誠邀符合以下條件的人士參與本次研究：
1. 18歲至24歲大專生
2. 有失眠症狀及遲睡傾向(凌晨12點後才睡覺)
3.  過去三個月沒有接受失眠及情緒心理治療或藥物治療
您需要做什麼？
∎ 填寫網上評估問卷
∎佩戴睡眠手錶及填寫睡眠日記
∎完成 7 日簡短錄音錄影紀錄當下狀態（每日兩次，每次約１—２分鐘）
∎手機應用程式上的網上治療課程​ ，共6個單元，​每一星期睇一個單元 （15-30分鐘）
∎在完成治療​後的一星期及６個月後，會邀請你再填寫網上評估問卷及和配戴睡眠手錶
如有興趣，請即登記並填寫簡單的網上篩查問卷：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_09uYGHApXoC8CDY
研究小組將會聯絡適合參與本研究的人士並進一步解釋研究詳情。閣下登記時留下的資料僅供研究用途，絕對保密。如閣下對是項研究有任何查詢，請電郵
sleepresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
或 WhatsApp: (+852 47544464 吳小姐) 查詢。
The Department of Psychiatry at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a research study to evaluate the effectiveness of a mobile app-based cognitive behavioral therapy program combined with a circadian rhythm intervention in improving sleep and mental health among college/university students. We would like to invite participants aged between 18 and 24 to join the study. Details are as follows:
Inclusion criteria:
1.  College or university students aged between 18-24 years
2. Reporting symptoms of insomnia and a delayed sleep pattern, typically falling asleep after midnight.
3. Do not receive psychological, behavioural, or pharmacological treatment for insomnia or emotional problems in the past three months.
What will you do?
∎ Complete online questionnaires
∎ Wear the actigraphy watch and keep a sleep diary
∎ Record brief audio and video entries about your current state for 7 consecutive days (twice daily, 1–2 minutes each)
∎ Complete a  6-week intervention program through a mobile app-based  (one module per week,   15–30 minutes per module).
∎ Complete follow-up assessments and wear the actigraphy watch one week and six months after the intervention.
If you are interested, please register and complete a short screening questionnaire here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_09uYGHApXoC8CDY
The research team will contact eligible participants and further explain the details of the study. Information collected will be only used for research purpose and will be kept strictly confidential. If you have any enquiries, please contact us via email
sleepresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
or WhatsApp: (+852 47544464 Miss Ng).
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

The Department of Psychiatry at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a research study to evaluate the effectiveness of a mobile app-based cognitive behavioral therapy program combined with a circadian rhythm intervention in improving sleep and mental health among college/university students. We would like to invite participants aged between 18 and 24 to join the study. Details are as follows:
Inclusion criteria:
1.  College or university students aged between 18-24 years
2. Reporting symptoms of insomnia and a delayed sleep pattern, typically falling asleep after midnight.
3. Do not receive psychological, behavioural, or pharmacological treatment for insomnia or emotional problems in the past three months.
What will you do?
∎ Complete online questionnaires
∎ Wear the actigraphy watch and keep a sleep diary
∎ Record brief audio and video entries about your current state for 7 consecutive days (twice daily, 1–2 minutes each)
∎ Complete a  6-week intervention program through a mobile app-based  (one module per week,   15–30 minutes per module).
∎ Complete follow-up assessments and wear the actigraphy watch one week and six months after the intervention.
If you are interested, please register and complete a short screening questionnaire here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_09uYGHApXoC8CDY
The research team will contact eligible participants and further explain the details of the study. Information collected will be only used for research purpose and will be kept strictly confidential. If you have any enquiries, please contact us via email
sleepresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
or WhatsApp: (+852 47544464 Miss Ng).
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Optimizing air conditioning at a steady 25.5°C

title: [Max. HKD$1200] Recruiting Native Cantonese-speaking Grandparents with hearing loss and Grandchildren for an Interaction Experiment [長者認知及聽力測試報告; + 兒童IQ智商測試報告] 招募聽力損失長者及其孫子女參與互動實驗
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/08/28
»
Announcements
[Max. HKD$1200] Recruiting Native Cantonese-speaking Grandparents with hearing loss and Grandchildren for an Interaction Experiment [長者認知及聽力測試報告; + 兒童IQ智商測試報告] 招募聽力損失長者及其孫子女參與互動實驗 - Brain and Mind Institute
From: LEUNG Mei Yee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
我們是
香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（BMI）
的研究團隊。我們團隊誠摯邀請有聽力損失的長者及其孫子女來參與一項互動研究。
參與者需符合以下條件：
長者：
65歲或以上，存在聽力損失
，無其他已知認知障礙症狀， 且
有意願配戴助聽器
孩童：
6-9歲
，無其他已知發展問題，母語為廣東話
實驗內容：本實驗共分為兩節（每節約1.5至2小時）：
- 第一節：長者將獨自參與一項
認知及聽力檢測
（當日孫子女無需到場）
- 第二節：長者將與孫子女一同進行
簡單遊戲
，期間我們將使用安全且非侵入性的
「近紅外光譜儀」（fNIRS）
進行腦部掃描
- 請注意：參與者必須先完成第一節的實驗，且結果符合研究要求，方會獲邀參與第二節的實驗
完成整個實驗後，您可獲得：
- 長者：一份
認知能力測試報告
+ 一份
純音聽力測試報告
- 孩童：一份
非語言智商測試報告
+ 一份
價值HKD$80的禮物
報酬：
現金HKD$400-1200
，以及免費停車券（如適用）
實驗地點：香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（位於校園內）
如您對本研究感興趣，請點擊以下連結填寫報名表格：
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
如祖孫兩位初步符合條件，我們將會儘快與您聯絡！
如有疑問，請發送電郵至 meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk，
亦可致電或Whatsapp 95867123 查詢。
我們期待你的參與！
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are researchers from the
Brain and Mind Institute (BMI) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong
. Our team sincerely invites grandparents with hearing loss and their grandchildren for a social interaction study.
Participants need to be:
- Grandparent:
65+ years old with hearing loss
, with no other diagnosed cognitive impairment, interested in fitting hearing aids
- Grandchild:
6-9 years old
with no other developmental problems; speaking Cantonese as the first language
What is involved? The experiment consists of two sessions (approx. 1.5-2 hours each):
- Session 1: The grandparent will participate alone in a
cognitive and hearing test
. (The grandchild does not need to attend)
- Session 2: The grandparent and grandchild will participate together in some
simple games
while using
fNIRS
(
functional near-infrared spectroscopy
, safe and non-invasive!!!) brain scanning device
- NOTE: Participants must first complete Session 1 and meet the study's requirements to be invited to Session 2
What you'll get (upon completion of the entire study):
- For the grandparent:
A cognitive test report
and
a pure-tone audiometry
(hearing test) report
- For the child:
An non-verbal IQ test report
and
a gift (~HKD$80)
Reward:
HKD$400-1200 allowance
and free parking ticket.
Location: Brain and Mind Institute, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (In campus).
If you are interested in our study, please fill in the form below via the following link:
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
We will contact you afterwards if the dyad are suitable.
For inquiries, please contact: meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk,
call or Whatsapp 95867123.
We look forward to your participation!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

bodyText:

Announcements
Join Woo Sing Choir! Auditions Now Open for Lee Woo Sing College & CUHK Students 2026-27 和聲合唱團2026-27年度團員招募｜歡迎和聲書院及中大學生報名參與試音！ - Lee Woo Sing College
From: Fung Hoi Kuen
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
henryfung@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
和聲合唱團
現正展開2026-27年度成員招新！
我們誠摯邀請各位和聲同學及中大同學參與試音，成為和聲合唱團的一份子，令和諧之聲匯聚一堂。
和聲合唱團於2012年2月正式成立，即將迎來成立15週年。合唱團每年約有40至50名團員，是大學其中一個歷史悠久、規模最大的學生合唱團。團員每週於和聲音樂中心進行訓練，並積極參與書院高桌晚宴、迎新活動及不同典禮的演出。為展現團員一整年的學習成果，合唱團於每年下學期舉辦年度音樂會，與大學成員分享精彩的音樂演出。團員來自不同背景，包括本地生、內地生及國際生，大家各展所長，以歌手或樂手的身分一同演出，攜手組成和諧共融的音樂大家庭。
無論你是專業的歌者，又或只是對唱歌抱有熱愛之心，和聲合唱團都真誠地歡迎你，供你在活動中提升音樂水平，在台前表演，以及結交到學園中志同道合、一同熱愛歌唱的好友知音。
試音時間：
第一節：8月25日 (二) 下午1:00-2:30
第二節：9月8日 (二) 下午1:00-2:30
第三節：9月10日 (四) 晚上6:30-8:00
地點：和聲書院音樂中心（和聲書院南座地下G04室）
試音報名表格 (
需登入)
：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737334
如欲了解和聲合唱團的詳情及過往演出，歡迎瀏覽以下合唱團的網頁：
https://www.ws.cuhk.edu.hk/ws-choir/
如對和聲合唱團或試音活動有任何疑問，歡迎透過電郵聯絡我們 (
wscollege@cuhk.edu.hk
)。
誠摯期待各位成為和聲合唱團的一份子！
We are pleased to announce that the
“Woo Sing Choir (WS Choir)”
is now recruiting new members for academic year 2026-27, and we warmly invite you to audition and become part of our vibrant musical community!
Founded in February 2012, the WS Choir will soon celebrate its 15th anniversary. With around 40 to 50 members each year, it is one of the University’s longest-established and largest student choirs. The Choir rehearses weekly at the College’s Music Centre and performs at College High Table Dinners, orientation activities, ceremonies and other special occasions. Each year culminates in our Annual Concert during the second term, where members showcase their musical development and share an exciting programme of performances with the University community.
Whether you are an experienced vocalist or someone who loves to sing, the choir offers a wonderful opportunity to develop your musical skills, perform at college and university events, and build friendships with fellow music enthusiasts across Woo Sing College and CUHK.
Audition Details:
25 August (Tue), 1:00 - 2:30 PM
8 September (Tue), 1:00 - 2:30 PM
10 September (Thu), 6:30 - 8:00 PM
Venue: Music Centre, Room G04, G/F, Lee Woo Sing College
To sign up for an audition slot, please complete the registration form (sign-in required):
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737334
You may find more information about WS Choir on our official website:
https://www.ws.cuhk.edu.hk/ws-choir/
Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us at:
wscollege@cuhk.edu.hk
.
We look forward to meeting you as a member of WS Choir!

和聲合唱團於2012年2月正式成立，即將迎來成立15週年。合唱團每年約有40至50名團員，是大學其中一個歷史悠久、規模最大的學生合唱團。團員每週於和聲音樂中心進行訓練，並積極參與書院高桌晚宴、迎新活動及不同典禮的演出。為展現團員一整年的學習成果，合唱團於每年下學期舉辦年度音樂會，與大學成員分享精彩的音樂演出。團員來自不同背景，包括本地生、內地生及國際生，大家各展所長，以歌手或樂手的身分一同演出，攜手組成和諧共融的音樂大家庭。
無論你是專業的歌者，又或只是對唱歌抱有熱愛之心，和聲合唱團都真誠地歡迎你，供你在活動中提升音樂水平，在台前表演，以及結交到學園中志同道合、一同熱愛歌唱的好友知音。

第一節：8月25日 (二) 下午1:00-2:30
第二節：9月8日 (二) 下午1:00-2:30
第三節：9月10日 (四) 晚上6:30-8:00
地點：和聲書院音樂中心（和聲書院南座地下G04室）
試音報名表格 (
需登入)
：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737334

https://www.ws.cuhk.edu.hk/ws-choir/
如對和聲合唱團或試音活動有任何疑問，歡迎透過電郵聯絡我們 (
wscollege@cuhk.edu.hk
)。
誠摯期待各位成為和聲合唱團的一份子！
We are pleased to announce that the
“Woo Sing Choir (WS Choir)”
is now recruiting new members for academic year 2026-27, and we warmly invite you to audition and become part of our vibrant musical community!
Founded in February 2012, the WS Choir will soon celebrate its 15th anniversary. With around 40 to 50 members each year, it is one of the University’s longest-established and largest student choirs. The Choir rehearses weekly at the College’s Music Centre and performs at College High Table Dinners, orientation activities, ceremonies and other special occasions. Each year culminates in our Annual Concert during the second term, where members showcase their musical development and share an exciting programme of performances with the University community.
Whether you are an experienced vocalist or someone who loves to sing, the choir offers a wonderful opportunity to develop your musical skills, perform at college and university events, and build friendships with fellow music enthusiasts across Woo Sing College and CUHK.

25 August (Tue), 1:00 - 2:30 PM
8 September (Tue), 1:00 - 2:30 PM
10 September (Thu), 6:30 - 8:00 PM
Venue: Music Centre, Room G04, G/F, Lee Woo Sing College
To sign up for an audition slot, please complete the registration form (sign-in required):
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737334

https://www.ws.cuhk.edu.hk/ws-choir/

wscollege@cuhk.edu.hk
.
We look forward to meeting you as a member of WS Choir!

Announcements
[Free of charge] [An allowance of up to HKD $1,000 will be provided upon successful enrollment] Recruitment of Diabetes Patients (Aged 18-70 years) for clinical trials of Chinese Medicine (Powder) Treatment [費用全免] [成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼] 招募年齡介於 18-70 歲的糖尿病人士- 中藥(沖劑)治療臨床研究 - Department of Medicine and Therapeutics
From: Maggie Lee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
maggielee@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[
新中藥方劑治療
2
型糖尿病的臨床安全性、有效性和多組評價：對
β
細胞功能和胰島素抵抗的影響】
香港中文大學內科及藥物治療學系與香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正聯合進行一項為期36週，以內服中藥(沖劑)治療 2 型糖尿病人
 研究對象：18至70歲華人
沒有重大疾病，沒有服用中藥， 身體質量指數 (BMI) ≥18 kg/m²  (公斤 ÷ 米 ÷ 米)
不吸煙或已戒煙至少 12 個月，如女性目前未懷孕
患糖尿病未滿 6 年，且在過去 3 個月內未使用任何降血糖藥物（包括胰島素）治療
至少具備以下其中一項風險因素:
糖尿病家族史 (尤其父母或兄弟姐妹在40歲前診斷 )
代謝綜合症 (3高：高血糖，高血壓，高膽固醇)
超重或肥胖
脂肪肝
多囊卵巢綜合症
妊娠糖尿病病史
如不確定自己是否患有糖尿病，會安排你服用葡萄糖飲料（75 克口服葡萄糖耐量試驗）
研究內容：中西醫評估、心電圖、肝纖維化掃描、抽血檢查、填寫問卷、服用研究中藥或安慰劑等
地點：新界沙田威爾斯醫院，舊座，3 樓，3M 病房 - 糖尿及內分泌研究中心
參與研究費用全免，成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼，名額有限，先到先得！
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名參加：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692
如果初步合適參與研究，負責同事將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電  3505 3897 / 6937 3365 或 WhatsApp 6937 3365與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。
[Clinical safety, efficacy and multiomic evaluation of a novel Chinese Medicine formula in Type 2 diabetes: Effects on beta-cell function and insulin resistance
.]
Department of Medicine and Therapeutics and Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK are jointly conducting a 36-week clinical study on the use of oral traditional Chinese medicine (granule form) for treating type 2 diabetes.
Eligibility Criteria: Ethnic Chinese individuals aged 18 to 70 years
No major illnesses, not currently taking any traditional Chinese medicine, and with a Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 18 kg/m² (kg ÷ metre ÷ metre)
Non-smokers or those who have quit smoking for at least 12 months; females must not be currently pregnant
Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes for less than 6 years and have not used any glucose-lowering medications (including insulin) in the past 3 months
Must have at least one of the following risk factors:
Family history of diabetes (especially if parents or siblings were diagnosed before age of 40)
Metabolic syndrome (three highs: high blood sugar, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol)
Overweight or obesity
Fatty liver
Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
History of gestational diabetes
If you are unsure whether you have diabetes, a 75g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) will be arranged for you.

Study Procedures Include:
Chinese and Western medical assessments, Electrocardiogram (ECG), Liver fibrosis scan, Blood tests, Questionnaire completion, Taking either the study Chinese medicine or a placebo
Location: Ward 3M, 3/F, Old Block, Diabetes and Endocrinology Research Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin, New Territories
Free of charge to participate.
Successful participants may receive an allowance of up to HKD $1,000.
Limited quota – first come, first served!
Register via the following link:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692
If you are eligible based on initial assessment, our research team will contact you shortly. Thank you!
For inquiries, please contact:
3505 3897 / 6937 3365
WhatsApp: 6937 3365
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

/weekly/

A new semester is coming! Want to diversify your CUHK experience, sharpen your appreciation skills of art and culture, or meet amazing new friends? The “Art Museum Ambassador Scheme” is the perfect fit for you!
To become an AMA, you must:
1. be a current CUHK student (full-time or part-time).
2. be passionate about arts and culture, curious about museums, and eager to explore the connections between artifacts and everyday life.
3. attend the interview-cum-briefing session (details in the application form).

bodyText:

Announcements
Microsoft Copilot Chat Tips Rewrite Text for Any Tone  - ITSC
From: ITSC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
itsc@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Ever wonder if your message sounds too formal? Too casual? Too blunt?
Copilot
can take
any text you paste
and instantly rewrite it in different tones. It’s like having a style consultant for your writing — just paste, pick your vibe, and go!
Try this prompt — copy & paste it!
"Rewrite the following message in 3 different tones: (1) formal and professional, (2) friendly and casual, (3) brief and direct. Here’s the original message: 'Hey team, just a reminder that the quarterly reports are due by end of day Friday. Please make sure your sections are completed and reviewed before submitting. Let me know if you need any help.'"
Why this works:
Asking for multiple versions in one go lets you compare and pick the best fit — or mix and match parts from each version. It’s faster than asking one at a time!

Bonus tip:
Great for when you’re unsure if your message sounds too harsh, too casual, or just right! Seeing side-by-side comparisons makes the choice easy.
More Tips & Resources
Looking for more ways to level up your Copilot game? Check out previous
All IT - Microsoft Copilot Chat Usage Tips
for even more helpful guidance and best practices.

From: Wikie Chan
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
wik.chan@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
How do universities move from AI as a strategic aspiration to a tangible, sustainable reality?
Join us for an insightful online talk, "From Strategy to Ecosystem: The XJTLU Practice of Education + AI".
We are thrilled to welcome Dr Xin BI from Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (XJTLU), who will share how XJTLU is building an AI-driven educational ecosystem. Drawing on practices recognised by the IIOE Higher Education Digitalisation Pioneer Case Awards, the talk will explore three interconnected dimensions of AI integration:
Leadership: How university leadership aligns strategy, governance, and resource allocation to drive the AI vision.
Pedagogy: How faculty translate AI into classroom practice, supported by professional development to foster AI literacy and personalised learning.
Technology: How strategic intent is converted into working platforms, including the XIPU AI Agent and the Learning Mall ecosystem.
Whether you are an educator, institutional leader, or ed-tech enthusiast, this talk will offer practical, transferable insights into reshaping the educational paradigm.

title: Recruiting households for participation in a serology study on RSV epidemiology 誠邀住戶參與呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)血清流行病學研究
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/08/21
»
Announcements
Recruiting households for participation in a serology study on RSV epidemiology 誠邀住戶參與呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)血清流行病學研究 - S.H. Ho Research Centre for Infectious Diseases
From: Dr. CHAN Chin Pok, Tony
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ceidstudy@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學何善衡傳染病研究中心現正進行一項全港性研究，旨在透過血清學檢測分析呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)於本港人口流行及傳播的模式。
我們現邀請本地住戶參與此研究。參與住戶及其成員需符合以下條件：
單位中有多於一人居住 (非獨居)；
住戶內需有多於一半成員參與此研究
(例：2-3人住戶需至少2名成員參加；4-5人住戶需至少3名成員參加)；
沒有接種RSV疫苗 或 參與相關臨床試驗研究；
現時沒有懷孕；及
於過去6個月通常居住於香港
研究內容:
參加者需於接下來的12個月合共抽血5次 ，並每月填答簡單問卷
未滿18歲參加者以「篤手指」方式進行
介乎2-5歲的參加者則無需抽血
本研究亦提供快速檢測包供參加者於出現呼吸道病徵時進行檢測 (費用全免)
地點:
沙田威爾斯親王醫院研究中心 (抽血/篤手指)
位於佐敦的私人診所 (抽血)
年滿6歲的參加者於完成所有抽血及問卷回合後可獲最多HK$250超市禮券。2-5歲的參加者則可於完成所有問卷回合後獲贈高達$100便利店禮券。名額有限，先到先得。如住戶有興趣參與研究，請登入
https://tinyurl.com/cuhkceid-rsv
填答網上表格。如符合參與資格，研究人員將會與你聯絡。
如有疑問，請於辦公時間致電2252-8862，WhatsApp 9244-8827 或傳送電郵至ceidstudy@cuhk.edu.hk 。
多謝支持！
S.H. Ho Research Centre for Infectious Diseases, The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a territory-wide serology study to analyse the population burden and epidemiology of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).
All local households are invited to join the study. Participating households and members should fulfil the conditions below:
Not living alone;
More than half of the members in the household should participate in this study
(e.g. at least 2 participants for 2-3 persons-households; at least 3 participants for 4-5 persons-households);
No history of RSV vaccination nor participation in related clinical trials;
Not being pregnant; and
Normally residing in Hong Kong in the past 6 months
About the study:
Participants aged 6 years or above are asked to provide blood samples for totally 5 rounds and complete monthly surveys in the ensuing 12 months
Blood samples would be collected by “finger-prick” for those aged below 18 years
Participants aged 2-5 years are exempted from blood sampling
This study also offers rapid tests for self-testing by participants whenever presenting with respiratory symptoms (free of charge)
Venue:
Research clinic in the Prince of Wales Hospital (blood-taking / finger-prick)
Private clinic in Jordan (blood-taking only)
Participants aged 6 years or above would be offered up to HK$250 supermarket voucher after a total of 5 rounds of blood-taking. Participants aged 2-5 years would be offered up to HK$100 convenience store voucher after a total of 5 survey rounds. Limited quotas - first come first served! Interested households please log in to
https://tinyurl.com/cuhkceid-rsv
and fill in the online form. If you are eligible for the study, research staff will be in contact with you shortly.
Should you have any enquiries, please contact us at 2252-8862, via WhatsApp 9244-8827, or by email (
ceidstudy@cuhk.edu.hk
) during office hours.
Thank you for your support.

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:

summaryEvidence: Ho Research Centre for Infectious Diseases, The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a territory-wide serology study to analyse the population burden and epidemiology of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).

Participating households and members should fulfil the conditions below: Not living alone; More than half of the members in the household should participate in this study (e.g. at least 2 participants for 2-3 persons-households; at least 3 participants for 4-5 persons-households); No history of RSV vaccination nor participation in related clinical trials; Not being pregnant; and Normally residing in Hong Kong in the past 6 months About the study: Participants aged 6 years or above are asked to provide blood samples for totally 5 rounds and complete monthly surveys in the ensuing 12 months Blood samples would be collected by “finger-prick” for those aged below 18 years Participants aged 2-5 years are exempted from blood sampling This study also offers rapid tests for self-testing by participants whenever presenting with respiratory symptoms (free of charge) Venue: Research clinic in the Prince of Wales Hospital (blood-taking / finger-prick) Private clinic in Jordan (blood-taking only) Participants aged 6 years or above would be offered up to HK$250 supermarket voucher after a total of 5 rounds of blood-taking.

We are now inviting Hong Kong young adults to participate in a bereavement survey, titled “Trajectories of grief outcomes and the associated psychosocial predictors among recently bereaved young adults in Hong Kong: A retrospective longitudinal mixed-methods approach”. Participants will receive up to HK$300 coupons upon completion.
Participant Inclusion Criteria:
Local young adults aged 18 to 29 residing in Hong Kong.
Have experienced the death of a close friend/relative or an important person within the past 18 months.
Able to read Chinese and communicate in Cantonese.
1) Baseline Questionnaire
- After signing the consent form, participants will complete a 20-minute baseline questionnaire.
- The questionnaire will include questions about grieving process in response to the death of a loved one or significant person, and attitudes toward death
- Participants will receive HK$100 coupons for completing the baseline questionnaire.
2) First Follow-up Questionnaire
- Six months later, participants who have completed the baseline questionnaire will be invited to complete a follow-up questionnaire.
- Participants who complete the first follow-up questionnaire will be rewarded with HK$100 coupons.
3) Second Follow-up Questionnaire
- Six months after the first follow-up questionnaire, participants who have completed the first follow-up questionnaire will be invited to complete a second follow-up questionnaire.
- Participants who complete the second follow-up questionnaire after will be rewarded with HK$100 coupons.
Participation in this study is voluntary. The study data will be kept confidential and no one other than the researchers will have access to the questionnaire information or audio recordings completed by the participants. This study has been approved by The Joint CUHK-NTEC CREC (CREC-2025.748) and the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics Committee of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (SBRE‐24‐0378).
Please use the following link to fill out the consent form and questionnaire. Upon completion, you will be rewarded with HK$100 coupons.
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4SbSwIIE6shc67I
You are welcome to recommend this recruitment information to qualified young adults in Hong Kong.

Announcements
HK$250 Stipend: Two-Person fNIRS Experiment for Chinese Mainland Students-Come with your travel companion! 250港币酬劳: 双人近红外实验机会，面向中国大陆学生 – 与你的旅行朋友一起来体验吧！ - Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
From: Xiaohui RAO
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你对自己的大脑了解吗？你知道你跟小伙伴在交流对话过程中的共脑表现吗？不要错过这样一次难得的双人实验机会噢！！
本实验室使用临床级安全的近红外脑图系统，收集人大脑局部的耗氧变化，不会对人体产生伤害。有任何安全顾虑都可以和研究人员联系了解：
Miss RAO,
1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk
实验日期：August 24 to August 30, 2026;
September 14 to September 30, 2026;
实验时长：每次60-65分钟，共两次，可分别在同一天的上下午完成（包括实验准备20分钟，任务30-35分钟，填问卷5分钟）。
实验内容：1）佩戴近红外设备，参加互动实验，；2）填写一些问卷。
实验地点：中文大学梁銶琚楼G层（语言学系）G34实验室。
实验结束后，会通过转数快/现金/百佳优惠券来支付250港元被试费用。
参与者需要符合以下要求：
1. 母语为汉语普通话；
2. 视力（矫正后）正常，听力正常；
3. 无脑损伤、癫痫等神经类疾病，无头皮外伤或感染；
4. 右利手（写字，用筷子等习惯使用右手）；
5. 实验当天不化妆，实验当天或前一晚在家自行洗头；
6. 可以接受在实验过程上戴上类似脑电设备的头套（实验结束后无需洗头）
7. 有共同旅游经历的两位同性别朋友，共同线下参与实验
8. 旅游经历发生在近两个月内，且旅行时间跨度2天1晚及以上
报名链接：
https://www.wjx.top/vm/huu9JXm.aspx#
香港中文大学语言学及现代语言系
如有问题，请联系饶女士（1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk）
This research is endorsed by
Prof. CAI Zhenguang

bodyText:

2026/08/21
»
Announcements
Latest Arrangements for School Bus Service (Effective from September 1, 2026) 校巴服務最新安排 (2026年9月1日起生效) - Transport Office
From: Transport Office
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
transport_office@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
2026年9月1日（星期二）起，校巴服務將作以下調整：
穿梭
校巴服務
1.
1A
線
將改為1線，開出時間為每小時逢10、25、40及55分，服務時間為上午7時40分至下午6時55分。
2.
1B
線
將會取消。
3. 新增
2S
線
，開出時間為每小時逢00及30分，服務時間為上午8時至下午6時30分。路線為
大學站廣場＞研究生宿舍一座＞大學體育中心＞邵逸夫堂＞馮景禧樓＞聯合書院（上行）＞新亞書院＞聯合書院（下行）＞大學行政樓＞善衡書院＞研究生宿舍一座＞大學站。
4.
2
線
將取消每小時逢00及30分班次，現有每小時逢15及45分班次則維持不變。
5.
8
線
將改由康本園開出，並停靠環迴東站（上行）及敬文書院（上行）站後，繼續按現有路線行車。康本園開出時間為每小時逢15、35及55分，服務時間為上午7時35分至下午6時35分。
6.
H
線
將取消停靠十苑站。
轉堂校巴服務
7.
7
線
開出時間將更改為每小時逢00及18分，服務時間為星期一至五上午8時18分至下午5時18分，星期六上午8時18分至下午1時18分
有關行車路線及時間表等資訊詳情，請瀏覽交通處網頁：
https://transport.cuhk.edu.hk/tc/
Starting from September 1, 2026 (Tuesday), there will be changes to the on-campus school bus service:
Shuttle School Bus Service
1.
Route 1A
will be renamed as Route 1.  The bus will depart at every 10, 25, 40 and 55 minutes each hour, with service hours from 7:40 a.m. to 6:55 p.m.
2.
Route 1B
will be cancelled.
3. A new
Route 2S
will be introduced.  The bus will depart at every 00 and 30 minutes each hour, with service hours from 8:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m.  The routing is:
Station Piazza > Postgraduate Hall 1 > Univ. Sports Centre > Sir Run Run Shaw Hall > Fung King Hey Bldg. > United College (Upward) > New Asia College > United College (Downward) > Univ. Admin. Bldg. > S.H. Ho College > Postgraduate Hall 1 > Univ. Station
.
4. Departures of
Route 2
at every 00 and 30 minutes each hour will be cancelled, while the existing departures at every 15 and 45 minutes each hour will remain unchanged.
5.
Route 8
will start from Y.I.A.P., then stop at Campus Circuit East (Upward) and CW Chu College (Upward) before continuing along its existing route.  Departures from Y.I.A.P. will be at every 15, 35 and 55 minutes each hour, with service hours from 7:35 a.m. to 6:35 p.m.
6.
Route H
will no longer stop at Residence No. 10.
Meet-class School Bus Service
7. The departure times of
Route 7
will be changed to every 00 and 18 minutes each hour.  The service hours will be from 8:18 a.m. to 5:18 p.m. on Mondays to Fridays, and from 8:18 a.m. to 1:18 p.m. on Saturdays.
For details of the route map and timetable, please visit the Transport Office webpage:
https://transport.cuhk.edu.hk/

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

title: Special OfferOH! Inspiration | Image Card Dialogue Workshop 特別優惠靈感「卡」住咗｜圖卡對話工作坊
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/08/21
»
Announcements
Special OfferOH! Inspiration | Image Card Dialogue Workshop 特別優惠靈感「卡」住咗｜圖卡對話工作坊 - psychology
From: 1M1A
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
manheichan@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
喺人際互動入面，我哋成日不知不覺背負咗他人嘅期望、自己設下嘅框架。究竟呢啲無形嘅枷鎖，點樣影響我哋同自己、同他人嘅關係？「靈感卡住咗」工作坊將透過 OH卡嘅直覺連結，同你一齊揭開微妙情緒，重新探索：被隱藏嘅真實自我渴望點樣嘅對話？
In interpersonal interactions, we often unconsciously carry the expectations of others and the boundaries we set for ourselves. How do these invisible shackles affect our relationships with ourselves and others? The "Stuck on Inspiration" workshop uses the intuitive connections of OH Cards to uncover subtle emotions with you, re-exploring: What kind of dialogue does your hidden, true self long for?
​參與者只需帶住好奇心，喺安全嘅交流空間入面，一齊照見關係入面嘅自己。
Participants only need to bring their curiosity to reflect upon themselves within relationships in a safe space for exchange.
​ 對象 / Target Audience: 15–30歲｜名額8人 / Ages 15–30 | Capacity: 8 people
​ 日期 / Dates: 2026年8月4日、25日（星期二） / August 4 & 25, 2026 (Tuesdays)
⏰ 時間 / Time: 2:15pm–3:45pm / 2:15 PM – 3:45 PM
地點 / Venue: 恆安體育館活動室 / Activity Room, Heng On Sports Centre
語言 / Language: 以廣東話主導，普通話輔助 / Mainly Cantonese, supplemented with Mandarin
​ 費用 / Fee: 正價$80/人 / Regular price $80/person
​‼限時優惠 / Limited-Time Offer‼
Follow 一月一藝術嘅ig（@1month1art）或facebook，然後like 一個你感興趣嘅post，就可以$20至抵價報名！參加者須於活動開始前出示證明
Follow 1 Month 1 Art on Instagram (@1month1art) or Facebook, and like a post you find interesting to register at a special discounted price of $20! Participants must show proof before the activity begins.
​ 報名方法 / How to Register:
填妥Google Form報名表，並按指示完成付款程序。名額有限，先到先得！
Fill out the Google Form registration and follow the instructions to complete the payment process. Places are limited and offered on a first-come, first-served basis!
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSexg95I6JDNmegRlEWwhG3FRMYHx7J5inmx1FIeUsJsrpMDHA/viewform
​⏳ 截止報名日期 / Registration Deadline: 2026年8月23日 August 23, 2026
​ 導師資歷 / Instructor Profile:
​吳卓琳（Jelina）
​持有幼兒教育學士及香港城市大學輔導學社會科學碩士
Holds a Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood Education and a Master of Social Sciences in Counselling from City University of Hong Kong
​多年深入參與幼兒教育、親子關係、情緒表達、家庭支援及藝術治療領域
Deeply involved for years in early childhood education, parent-child relationships, emotional expression, family support, and art therapy
​現於香港中文大學心理學系負責「十八有藝」社區藝術計劃之成效研究，推動藝術與日常連結及社區創作文化
Currently responsible for research on the effectiveness of the "18 Districts Arts Gala" community arts scheme at the Department of Psychology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, promoting the connection between art and daily life as well as community creative culture
​曾主持超過四十場以圖像、故事與藝術為媒介的OH卡活動
Has hosted over 40 OH Card sessions utilizing imagery, storytelling, and art as media
​參與多項心理與社會情緒相關團體工作，具跨領域及跨年齡層帶領經驗，包括自閉症（ASD）家庭團體支援、青春期兒童情緒輔導、個人職業與壓力輔導等
Participated in numerous psychological and socio-emotional group projects with interdisciplinary and cross-age group experience, including support groups for families with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), emotional counseling for adolescents, and individual career and stress counseling
​曾任心理服務公司項目負責人，主理親子輔導項目及企業EAP活動
Former project lead at a psychological services company, overseeing parent-child counseling projects and corporate EAP activities
​創立圖像故事療癒品牌，設計多項OH卡活動與團體課程
Founded an image-storytelling healing brand, designing various OH Card activities and group courses
​以清晰且具結構之方式帶領活動，陪伴參加者於安全空間中表達、整理與看見自己，讓藝術成為生活中可持續的力量
Facilitates activities in a clear and structured manner, accompanying participants in expressing, organizing, and discovering themselves within a safe space, making art a sustainable force in everyday life

For enquiries, please write to:

‼CUHK Chrisian Choir is recruiting new members! Register to our Open Rehersals NOW‼ ‼中大基督徒詩班（CUCC）招收中‼ - The Chinese University of Hong Kong Christian Choir
From: The Chinese University of Hong Kong Christian Choir
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
z120319@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
‼中大基督徒詩班（CUCC）招收中‼
我哋招收緊新班員同司琴呀‼
我哋係一班喺中大用合唱音樂事奉嘅人 如果你對唱歌有興趣，想用音樂服侍神，又想認識志同道合嘅人，咁CUCC就啱晒你啦

午間講座 - 慢性胃炎的中醫辨治與飲食宜忌
TCM Tips for Chronic Gastritis: How to Eat, Heal, and Protect Your Stomach
慢性胃炎屬中醫常見脾胃病範疇，胃脹胃痛令人困擾，甚至影響情緒。所謂「三分治、七分養」，講座分享如何識別脾胃問題、了解不同體質的飲食宜忌、示範簡易養胃穴位保健法，教大家以中醫方式應對這場保「胃」戰
Chronic gastritis is a super common pi-wei (spleen and stomach) issue in TCM. Dealing with a bloated or painful stomach is really frustrating and can easily ruin your mood. There is a famous saying in Chinese medicine: "Three parts treatment, seven parts nourishment." In this talk, you will learn how to spot pi-wei problems and find out what to eat (and what to avoid!) based on your unique body constitution. We will also show you some simple acupressure methods for stomach care to do at home. Come learn how to protect your stomach in TCM way!

攤位招募事宜
本年度學生事務處將於 2026年9月16日至18日 假 百萬大道及烽火台 舉辦為期三日的藝墟。活動旨在為中大註冊學生團體及中大部門提供宣傳及招募新會員的平台，同時讓一眾新生體驗豐富的中大學會文化。現場亦設有表演舞台，歡迎中大人踴躍參與，展示才華。
現正公開招募攤位，歡迎各中大註冊學生團體及中大部門踴躍申請。
活動及報名詳情
活動日期： 2026年9月16日至18日（星期三至五）
活動地點： 中文大學百萬大道及烽火台
報名截止日期： 2026年8月27日（星期四）晚上 11 時 59 分
費用及訂金
中大註冊學生團體： 費用 HK$600（另須繳交HK$400 訂金）
中大部門： 費用 HK$1000（另須繳交HK$500 訂金）
備註：成功申請的團體將收到電郵通知，屆時請依時前往學生事務處學生經驗及發展組（范克廉樓一樓）繳交費用及抽籤決定攤位位置。
報名方式
有意申請的團體，請於上述截止時間前填妥網上報名表格，請即按
2026 藝墟攤位招募事宜
報名。
如有任何查詢，歡迎電郵至 seds@cuhk.edu.hk，並關注本組 Instagram 專頁（@cuhk_osa_seds）以獲取最新資訊。

學生經驗及發展組
Dear students and staff,
Booth Application for Art Fair 2026
The Office of Student Affairs is pleased to announce that the Art Fair 2026 will take place from September 16 to 18, 2026 at the University Mall and The Beacon.
This 3-day event provides an ideal platform for affiliated student societies and CUHK departments to promote their activities and recruit new members, while offering freshmen immersive experience of CUHK’s vibrant campus culture. In addition to booths, a dedicated stage will be available for performances and showcases by members of the CUHK community.
Applications for booths are now open to all affiliated student societies and CUHK departments.
Event & Application Details
Event Dates:
September 16–18, 2026 (Wednesday–Friday)
Venue:
University Mall and the Beacon
Application Deadline:
August 27, 2026 (Thursday) at 11:59 PM
Application Fees & Deposit
Affiliated Student Societies of CUHK:
HK$600+HK$400 refundable deposit
CUHK Departments:
HK$1000+ HK$500 refundable deposit
Note: Successful applicants will receive a confirmation email with instructions on submitting the fee and participating in the booth allocation draw at the office of Student Experience & Development Section, Office of Student Affairs (1/F, Benjamin Franklin Centre).
Application Method
Interested parties are invited to submit the online application form by the deadline mentioned above. Please click
Booth Application for Art Fair 2026
for application.
For inquiries, please feel free to contact us via email at seds@cuhk.edu.hk or follow our Instagram page (@cuhk_osa_seds) for the latest updates.
Best regards,

Office of Student Affairs

日期： 2026年8月28日（星期五）、2026年9月11日（星期五）及2026年9月24日（星期四）
⏰ 時間： 下午2時至5時
地點： 威爾斯親王醫院（PWH）賽馬會公共衛生學院 209室 或 線上參與「以歌會友」活動 (連結於報名後發放)

二手衣物裝飾作品將在 9月開始在不同醫院巡迴展出，並於 12月大型展覽 中公開展示，向公眾分享你們與中風人士的創作成果。

From: Reimagining Yung Shue Au
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ysa-cuhk@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
「重塑榕樹凹：共創山海村落」—
地方營造大使招募
中文大學建築學院現正推動一項以「鄉郊地方營造（Rural Placemaking）」為核心的鄉村學堂及暑期工作坊，誠邀熱愛香港鄉郊文化、樂於親身參與實作的你，一同走進榕樹凹，參與村落景觀的復育與共創行動。
計劃期間，我們將邀請香港建造學院團隊擔任導師，帶領參加者學習傳統建造工藝及鄉郊實踐技術。參加者可自選出席一天或多天工作坊。若完成九天的工作坊後，參加者將獲頒由中文大學建築學院及香港建造學院簽發之服務證書，以作嘉許。
榕樹凹介紹：
榕樹凹位於新界東北端，於三百多年前開基立村，是一條歷史悠久的客家溫姓村落，村落鼎盛時期曾有逾三百名居民。由於地理位置接近邊境，榕樹凹在1980年代曾設有英軍軍營，留下了一段獨特而鮮為人知的歷史印記。雖然村落現已無人居住，但村民近年積極推動復村工作，透過修復祖屋、整理村史、舉辦村宴及傳統儀式，如籌辦麒麟隊；重建社群連結與文化記憶，展現出對深厚的鄉土感情與文化傳承精神。
****************************************
願景
共創鄉郊地方營造：以低碳修復與地方記憶，重塑山海景觀。
空間實作：以小型建設改善路徑與休憩空間。
感官敘事：將歷史轉化為具體的景觀導覽。
​共創行動：透過行動連結設計思考與鄉村振興。
****************************************
活動地點： 新界沙頭角榕樹凹村
****************************************
工作坊形式及階段:
鄉村導賞：認識榕樹凹村落歷史，了解鄉郊地方營造與文化地景。
物資收集：在山海與村落之間收集可用材料。
景觀實踐*：進行場地清理及空間建設實作，由香港建造學院導師帶領鄉村學堂，教授鄉郊景觀實踐技藝與傳統建造方法。
（ *
代表當日將由建造學院導師帶領鄉村學堂及景觀實踐活動。）
9月
1日（二）、8日（二）、15日（二）、16日（三）*、17日（四）*、22日（二）
實際工作坊日期將視乎報名人數、天氣及工作人員情況作適當調整，包括增加或減少工作坊次數，屈時會通知相關參加者及在宣傳平台上公布。
- 參加者可因應自身時間安排，選擇參與單日或多日工作坊。
- 請參加者選擇所有可出席日期，以便主辦單位安排及分組。
- 導賞活動日期將稍後公布，會安排在平日和假日或工作坊期間舉行。
- 實際工作坊日期將視乎報名人數、天氣及現場情況作適當調整，並另行通知相關參加者。
- 如出席一節鄉村導賞、八節工作坊可獲中大建築學院及香港建造學院之義工服務證書。
*************************************
活動時間：早上 09:00 至 下午 04:00
名額：每節12人。
*************************************
對象：
* 身體狀況良好，能應付長時間戶外活動人士
* 對建築、景觀設計、保育等感興趣的人士
****************************************
報名連結：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733829
- 如出席一節鄉村導賞、八日工作坊可獲中大建築學院及香港建造學院之義工服務證書。
****************************************
計劃名稱：
「重塑榕樹凹故事：透過實驗式社區場地及自然文化徑共創鄉郊地方營造」
合辦機構：
中文大學建築學院
香港建造學院
榕樹凹村
資助：
環境及生態局環境科 鄉郊保育辦公室「鄉郊保育資助計劃」
****************************************
備註：
1. 榕樹凹屬禁區範圍，參加者需預先申請禁區許可證方可前往。
2. 在項目進行期間，所有與工作坊相關的船程費用將由計劃負責安排及資助。參加者需要自行安排陸路交通，並準備足夠食物（午餐）和飲用水。
3. 工作坊將以粵語進行。
4. 工作坊內容或會因天氣、路況、項目進度，以及參加者或工作人員身體狀況而作臨時調整，恕不另行通知，敬請留意。
5. 工作坊涉及一定體力勞動及長時間戶外活動。如參加者有身體不適、舊患或其他健康狀況，請預先通知主辦單位。
6. 村內沒有士多或補給設施，請預先準備足夠飲用水、午餐、乾糧、防曬及防蚊用品，並按個人需要攜帶雨具。
7. 工作坊地點蚊蟲較多，建議穿著淺色長袖衣物及長褲，並按需要攜帶蚊怕水。
8. 工作坊已包括基本第三者責任保險，參加者可按需要自行購買其他保險。
9. 鄉郊地區路面或有高低不平、濕滑、碎石情況，參加者須小心步行。
10. 如參加者未有遵守安全指引或工作人員安排，主辦單位有權終止其參與工作坊。
11. 活動期間我們可能會拍攝或／及錄影以作記錄、報告、宣傳及推廣用途。如你不欲被攝入鏡，請在活動開始前告知工作人員，以便我們作出適當安排。
12. 如有查詢，請電郵至
ysa-cuhk@cuhk.edu.hk
或致電 3943 6520 /3943 6518.

“Reimagining Yung Shue Au: Co-creating a Mountain-Sea Village”
— Recruitment for Rural-placemaking Ambassadors
Re-telling the Yung Shue Au Story: Co-creating Rural Place
The School of Architecture at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently organising a rural school and summer workshop centred on the concept of
rural placemaking
. We invite individuals who are passionate about Hong Kong’s rural culture and interested in hands-on practice to join us in Yung Shue Au and participate in the revitalisation and co-creation of the village landscape.
During the programme, instructors from the Hong Kong Institute of Construction will lead participants in learning traditional construction crafts and rural practical skills. Participants may choose to attend one or multiple workshop sessions according to their availability. Those who complete nine workshop days will receive a service certificate jointly issued by the School of Architecture, CUHK and the Hong Kong Institute of Construction in recognition of their participation and contribution.
Introduction to Yung Shue Au
Located in the northeastern New Territories, Yung Shue Au is a historic Hakka village established over 300 years ago by the Wan clan. At its peak, the village was home to more than 300 residents. Owing to its proximity to the border, a British military camp was stationed in the village during the 1980s, leaving behind a unique yet little-known historical legacy.
Although the village is currently uninhabited, villagers have actively promoted village revitalisation in recent years through repairing ancestral houses, documenting village history, organising village banquets and traditional rituals, as well as reviving the Qilin dance team. These efforts reflect a deep attachment to the village and a strong commitment to cultural inheritance and community reconnection.
Vision
Co-creating Rural Placemaking
Reimagining the mountain-sea landscape through low-carbon restoration and local memories.
Spatial Practice
Improving pathways and communal resting spaces through small-scale construction.
Sensory Narratives
Transforming local history into tangible landscape interpretation experiences.
Collective Action
Connecting design thinking with rural revitalisation through practical engagement.
Venue:
Yung Shue Au, Sha Tau Kok, New Territories
Programme Format and Phases
Village Guided Tour
Understanding the history of Yung Shue Au and learning about rural placemaking and cultural landscapes.
Material Collection
Collecting usable materials from the surrounding mountain, coastal, and village environment.
Landscape Practice
Participating in site clearing and spatial construction workshops led by instructors from the Hong Kong Institute of Construction, focusing on rural landscape practices and traditional building techniques.
(* Stars indicate days when Hong Kong Institute of Construction instructors will lead the Landscape workshop.)
September
1 September (Tue), 8 September (Tue), 15 September (Tue), 16 September (Wed)*, 17 September (Thur)*, 22 September (Tue)
Please note that actual workshop dates are subject to adjustment based on enrollment numbers, weather conditions, and staff availability. This includes the potential to increase or decrease the number of sessions. Registered participants will be notified directly of any changes, and updates will be posted across our promotional platforms.
- Participants may choose to join single-day or multiple-day workshops according to their availability.
​- Participants are encouraged to select all available dates to facilitate scheduling and grouping arrangements.
- Indicates dates on which the landscape practice workshops will be led by instructors from the Hong Kong Institute of Construction.
- Dates for the guided tours will be announced later and will be arranged on both weekdays and weekends.
- Actual workshop dates may be adjusted according to registration numbers, weather conditions, and site situations. Relevant participants will be notified separately.
Workshop Time
09:00 am – 04:00 pm
Capacity
12 participants per session
Target Participants
Individuals in good physical condition who are able to participate in long hours of outdoor activities
Individuals interested in architecture, landscape design, conservation, and related fields
Registration Link
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733829
Participants who attend one village guided tour and eight workshop sessions will receive a volunteer service certificate jointly issued by the School of Architecture, CUHK and the Hong Kong Institute of Construction.
Project Title
“Re-telling the Yung Shue Au Story: Co-creating Rural Place with Experimental Communal Hub and Eco-Cultural Trail”
Organisers
School of Architecture, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong Institute of Construction
Yung Shue Au Village
Funding Support
Countryside Conservation Office
Environment Branch, Environment and Ecology Bureau
Countryside Conservation Funding Scheme
Remarks
1. Yung Shue Au is located within a restricted area. Participants are required to apply for a Closed Area Permit in advance.
2. During the project period, all boat transportation costs related to the workshops will be arranged and subsidised by the project. Participants are responsible for their own land transportation and should prepare sufficient food and drinking water.
3. The workshops will be conducted in Cantonese.
4. Workshop arrangements may be adjusted due to weather, road conditions, project progress, or the physical conditions of participants and staff without prior notice.
5. The workshops involve physical labour and extended outdoor activities. Participants with health conditions, previous injuries, or physical discomfort are advised to inform the organisers in advance.
6. There are no shops or supply facilities in the village. Participants should prepare sufficient drinking water, sun protection, mosquito repellent, and rain gear if necessary.
7. Mosquitoes and insects are common at the workshop site. Participants are advised to wear light-coloured long-sleeved clothing and long trousers, and bring insect repellent if needed.
8. Basic third-party liability insurance is included. Participants may arrange additional insurance at their own discretion.
9. Rural paths may be uneven, slippery, or covered with loose gravel. Participants should walk carefully.
10. The organisers reserve the right to terminate participation if safety instructions or staff arrangements are not followed.
11. Photographs and/or video recordings may be taken during the activities for documentation, reporting, publicity, and promotional purposes. Participants who do not wish to appear in photographs or recordings should inform staff before the activity begins.
12. For enquiries, please contact
ysa-cuhk@cuhk.edu.hk
or call 3943 6520 / 3943 6518.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

The VeriGuide System will undergo scheduled maintenance and an upgrade from 29 August 2026 (Saturday) to 30 August 2026 (Sunday).
The maintenance window will begin at 3:00 a.m. on 29 August and continue until 11:59 p.m. on 30 August 2026 (GMT+8). The system will be unavailable throughout the maintenance window, and users will not be able to access the service. Hello! I am a PhD student at the Department of English (Applied English Linguistics). I invite you to a study examining the relationship between English viewing and learning.
If you decide to participate, I will ask you to take part in
three sessions
. (Location: Fung King Hey building).
The 1st session: You will watch a video clip. Your eye-movement during viewing will be recorded.
The 2nd session: You will take several English tests.
The 3rd session: You will take different memory tests.
In return for your participation, I am able to offer you
120
HKD
at the end of the 3rd session.
In order to participate in this study, you need to satisfy all the following criteria: (1) aged 18 or above, (2) native speaker of Cantonese/Mandarin, (3) your English proficiency should be in the following ranges:
DSE: 4-5
IELTS: 6.0-7.5
TOEFL iBT: 75-109
If you want to participate in this study, please complete this online survey so that I can contact you and schedule your sessions.
Link:
https://forms.gle/KvFebEcwZau9mdtS9
If you have any queries about the study, please feel free to contact me at jiaxuan.yu@link.cuhk.edu.hk. I would be very grateful if you would agree to take part! :-)

Leadership Study Participants Recruitment 【完成線上研究，可獲HKD100報酬】誠意邀請香港小學生及家長參與領導力相關心理學研究（尤其期盼小二、小五、小六學生參與！） - Gender Studies Programme
From: HE Chuting
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
conniehe@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你想了解孩子對於學校或日常生活裡的“領導”的看法嗎？想知道孩子對於“當領導”的意願嗎？不要錯過這次有趣又有意義的研究機會。簡單進行線上研究，還有報酬可領喔~~
招募對象
：
在香港就讀小1到小6的小學生以及其父親或母親
目前各個組別依舊在積極招募，尤其小2、小5、小6組別以及各個組別的女孩子組依舊席位多多！誠摯邀請合乎要求的小朋友同家長參與~~如果你們身邊有合乎要求的小朋友和家長，也懇請幫我們多多宣傳~~
研究項目：
小學生、家長及老師的領導認知與刻板印象
研究內容：
1.孩子：1對1線上訪談（需錄音），約需1小時。
2.家長：填寫1份網上問卷，約需1小時。
報酬：
家長和孩子完成各自的研究項目後，可獲得共100港幣報酬。
參與條件：
1.兒童參加者為在港就讀小1到小6的小學生，家長參加者為該兒童的父親或母親。
2.兒童能講流利廣東話或普通話，家長能閱讀和書寫中文。
3.兒童可使用有互聯網、視頻和音頻功能的電腦或平板參與研究。
4.兒童沒有主要的身體障礙（如：視障、四肢不健全）和未被診斷有任何有關精神健康或主要的發展障礙的狀況（如：自閉症、過度活躍）。
5.請留意參加者需在此前沒有參與過本研究的“預實驗”或“教師部分”（如不清楚是否參與過也可先留下聯繫方式，稍後我們的研究人員將與您聯繫進行確認）。
如對本實驗感興趣，請通過以下鏈接報名
，我們的研究人員將盡快聯繫您：https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_6KzWB6HhTtOhwou
參與純屬自願性質，所收集的資料只作研究用途及保密處理。如有任何疑問，請聯繫何小姐（conniehe@link.cuhk.edu.hk)。

  [Online experiment] Looking for native English speakers
Prof. Haerim Hwang (Department of English, CUHK) is looking for participants for a study on language production.
Which participants are we looking for?
- English is your first/native and dominant language
- Your graduate degree is not in the field of linguistics
- Can use your laptop/computer and have access to stable internet (no smartphones, laptops, or hotspot)
- Can participate in an experiment on Zoom in a quiet environment
- Have Chrome on your laptop/computer
How do I participate?
1. Fill out this questionnaire
-- English speakers: https://forms.gle/ttuhGGCwRx2n95kBA
2. Our research team will reach out to you, confirming your availability.
3. It will take approximately 2 hours to complete these tasks.
What do I get out of the study?
You will get HK$250 in cash upon the completion of the task.
Your participation will enhance our understanding of how people process English sentences.
Questions?
Contact Prof. Haerim Hwang at haerimhwang@cuhk.edu.hk
Ethics Approval
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Survey and Behavioural Research Ethics Committee SBREC (fssc02@cuhk.edu.hk) has vetted the study (Approval ID: SBRE-22-0026D). If you have any concerns regarding ethics, please contact them.

Participants wanted for a Chinese reading research study
The Centre for Sign Linguistics and Deaf Studies at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a research study on Chinese reading and is recruiting participants.
Eligibility Criteria
Participants must:
Be between 18 and 50 years old
Be a full-time student at The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Have normal hearing
Have normal or corrected-to-normal vision
Have no history of neurological, language, or reading disorders
Have never learned any sign Language
In addition, participants must meet the requirements:
Native Cantonese speakers from Hong Kong
Proficient in reading and writing Traditional Chinese
Research procedures and sessions:
Participants will complete 1 computer-based judgment task and 3 eye-tracking experiments across 4 sessions, with each session lasting approximately 2 hours.
Location
Academic Building No. 2, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (near Hong Kong Science Park).
Allowance
Participants will receive HKD $100 upon completion of each session.
Notes
If you wear contact lenses, please also bring your glasses with you to the experiment.
Please do not wear progressive lenses or coloured contact lenses during the eye-tracking experiment sessions.
All identifiable personal information collected during the study will be kept strictly confidential. Participation in this study is not expected to cause any physical or psychological discomfort.
If you are interested, please complete the registration form:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9ELDNEDkVedp7Fk

From: Winifred Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學精神科學系正進行一項研究，旨在評估手機應用程式網上自助心理健康療程對改善青年睡眠及情緒健康的成效。現招募年齡介乎15歲至24歲青年研究。詳情如下:
我們誠邀符合以下條件的人士參與本次研究：
1. 15歲至24歲青年
2. 有失眠及情緒症狀
3. 過去三個月沒有接受失眠及情緒心理治療或藥物治療
您需要做什麼？
參與為期6週的手機App自助療程
每週觀看20分鐘左右的網上療程
完成四次網上問卷及七天睡眠日記，包括治療前、治療後、三個月跟進及六個月跟進
全部評估及治療皆在電話或網上進行，無需面見！
如有興趣，請即登記並填寫簡單的網上篩查問卷：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_domAhEzzCmdV2sK
研究小組將會聯絡適合參與本研究的人士並進一步解釋研究詳情。閣下登記時留下的資料僅供研究用途，絕對保密。如閣下對是項研究有任何查詢，請電郵
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
或 WhatsApp: (+852- 47544464 黃小姐)查詢。
The Department of Psychiatry at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a research study to evaluate the effectiveness of an online self-help mobile app program for improving sleep and emotional well-being among youths. We would like to invite participants aged between 15 and 24 to join the study. Details are as follows:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Youths aged between 15-24 years
2. Experience symptoms of insomnia and emotional distress
3. Have not received psychological or medication treatment for these issues in the past 3 months
What will you do?
Join a 6-week self-help treatment via mobile app
Attend 20 minutes of online therapy weekly
Complete four online surveys and seven-day sleep diary: before treatment, after treatment, at 3-month follow-up, and at 6-month follow-up during the study
All assessments and treatments are conducted via phone or online — no in-person visits required!
If you are interested, please register and complete a short screening questionnaire here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_domAhEzzCmdV2sK
The research team will contact eligible participants and further explain the details of the study. Information collected will be only used for research purpose and will be kept strictly confidential. If you have any enquiries, please contact us via email
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
or WhatsApp: (+852- 47544464 Miss Wong).
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

From: Jookyoung Jung

Participate in this study and earn
3
00 HKD! :)
English learning from computer-mediated English reading
Hello! I am Jookyoung Jung, Associate Professor at the Department of English. I'd like to invite you to a study that examines the relationship between computer-mediated English reading and English learning.
If you decide to participate, I will ask you to take part in three experimental sessions.
In
Session 1
, we will ask you to complete a brief questionnaire about yourself. Next, you will take English proficiency tests that measure your grammar and vocabulary.
In
Session 2
, you will read English texts while your eye movements are recorded using an eye-tracker.
In

本課程將介紹言語及語言障礙（Speech and Language Impairment）的基本知識，以及言語治療師在支援有溝通需要人士方面的重要角色。課程透過由經驗言語治療師及教授團隊預備的動畫教學、模擬及真實臨床資料、及互動學習活動，幫助同學認識言語及語言障礙的影響，同時培養尊重、同理心及共融價值觀。
課程特色
自主安排學習時間，按個人進度完成課程
互動學習模式
真實及模擬臨床資料
提升對特殊教育需要（SEN）的認識
培養同理心、尊重與共融精神 適合任何學科背景同學修讀

課程編號：
UGEB2996

課程名稱：
初探言語障礙與言語治療師角色

授課模式：
網上非同步學習（Online Asynchronous）

學分：
1 學分
NEWLY LAUNCHED!
Have you ever wondered how communication disorders affect a person's daily life and learning? Would you like to understand the role of Speech Therapists and learn how to communicate more effectively with individuals with communication needs?
This course introduces the fundamentals of Speech and Language Disorders (types of Special Educational Needs), and the important role of the Speech Therapist in supporting individuals with such communication needs. Through animated tutorials by our experienced team of Speech Therapists and Professors, the use of simulated and/or real clinical data, and interactive learning activities, students will gain both knowledge and awareness of the impact of Speech and Language Disorders, whilst developing empathy, respect and inclusive values.
Course Highlights
Flexible self-paced online learning
Interactive learning activities
Real and simulated clinical data
Enhance awareness of Special Educational Needs (SEN)
Foster empathy, respect, and inclusion

From: Jockey Club Museum of Climate Change (MoCC)
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
jaysonchan@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

賽馬會氣候變化博物館大使
2026/27
（上學期）
Calling for CUHK Students: MoCC Ambassadorship 2026/27 (1st-semester Cohort)
(See the English version after the Chinese version)
►
觀看博物館大使影片
◄
2026/27年度
賽馬會氣候變化博物館大使計劃
（上學期）現正接受申請。
賽馬會氣候變化博物館
誠邀所有中大全日制學生報名，一起推動氣候行動。
賽馬會氣候變化博物館大使
與博物館教育活動和日常運作息息相關，更是未來在社會推動可持續發展的領袖。入選的學生將會接受培訓，參與博物館的日常運作，例如接待訪客和帶領導賞團等，亦有機會協助籌辦博物館活動，如工作坊和外展教育活動。
此外，你亦
：
可以獲得免費培訓及專業發展；
有機會獲得旅費資助，出席COP31及其他國際會議；
有機會接受電台及其他媒體的訪問。
如果你：
就讀中大全日制課程（任何學科）；
享受與不同年齡和背景的人交流，並希望加強溝通和交流技巧；
期望擁有充實的大學生活和豐富的履歷表；或
希望為地球出一分力，倡導和推動氣候行動，
請即填妥
網上報名表
，成為我們的一分子！
截止報名日期：2026年9月23日（星期三）晚上11時59分
計劃詳情：
https://www.mocc.cuhk.edu.hk/mocc-ambassadorship
如有查詢，請致電3943 0817或電郵至
jaysonchan@cuhk.edu.hk
與陳先生聯絡。
►
Watch the MoCC Ambassadorship Video
◄
Applications for the 1st-semester cohort of the MoCC Ambassadorship 2026/27 are now open.  All full-time students of CUHK, regardless of academic background(s), are eligible to apply for promoting climate action.
MoCC Ambassadors are an integral part of the education and operations of the
Jockey Club Museum of Climate Change
(MoCC), and they are the future sustainability leaders of the society.  Selected students are given effective and engaging training and all-rounded service-learning opportunities.  For example, they will guide visitors on MoCC tours, assist in the MoCC’s outreach activities, workshops and climate education projects.
As an ambassador, you will also:
Receive free training and professional development;
Have the opportunity to receive a travel grant to attend COP31 and other international conferences;
Have the opportunity to be interviewed by radio and other media outlets.
Join us if you:
are a full-time CUHK student;
enjoy interacting with diverse audiences, from kindergarten children to senior citizens, and wish to develop your interpersonal and communication skills;
look forward to enriching your university experience and enhancing your CV; or
are committed to climate leadership and action.
Deadline: 11:59 pm, 23 September 2026 (Wednesday)
Online application
and details:
https://www.mocc.cuhk.edu.hk/mocc-ambassadorship
You are welcome to contact Mr Jayson Chan at 3943 0817 or
jaysonchan@cuhk.edu.hk
if you have any questions.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

title: 【$100 Coupon 】CUHK Allergy Team is Recruiting Healthy Children for Immune Testing 中大過敏科團隊誠邀非食物過敏兒童參與兒童免疫多組學圖譜研究
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/08/21
»
Announcements
【$100 Coupon 】CUHK Allergy Team is Recruiting Healthy Children for Immune Testing  中大過敏科團隊誠邀非食物過敏兒童參與兒童免疫多組學圖譜研究 - Department of Paediatrics
From: Ann Au
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
annwsau@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
疾病與腸道微生態息息相關，中大兒科過敏科團隊正在研究兒童食物過敏的成因及治療方案。您的孩子的血液及糞便樣本有助我們科研團隊更了解兒童食物過敏與腸道微生態等多組學的關係，更對濕疹、哮喘、鼻敏感等其他免疫系統疾病提供寶貴的參考，對未來的科研發展作出巨大的貢獻。
以下表格將會收集基本資料，以便研究團隊評核您／您的孩子是否合適參與此研究。如果您／您的孩子被選中，研究團隊將會聯絡您，並安排到威爾斯親王醫院 (Prince of Wales Hospital) 再詳細解釋研究流程及簽署同意書。 研究團隊會為參加者抽取血液及糞便樣本。參加者在完成該研究後可獲港幣$100餐飲券、血液報告乙份及腸道微生態報告乙份。
研究團隊會在閣下填妥表格一個月內聯絡合資格的申請者，假如申請一個月後團隊未有聯絡閣下，代表閣下未能通過初步篩選。
您所提供的資料會用作日後聯絡之用，只有獲本研究團隊授權人員方可查閱。如果您／您的孩子對填寫申請表格或研究詳情有任何疑問，請於辦公時間聯絡 9671 1756 查詢。
申請表格連結：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3yNko4UyWrBHCJg
==================================================================
As many diseases are closely related to the gut microbiome, the CUHK Paediatric Allergy team is currently investigating the causes of paediatric food allergy and its treatments. Your child’s blood and stool samples could enable our team to understand more about the relationship between food allergy and multi-omics fields, such as the gut microbiome. It would also serve as a valuable reference for other immunological diseases such as eczema, asthma, and allergic rhinitis, contributing greatly to future scientific research.
The team will assess if you/your child’s eligibility to participate in this study with the form linked below. The team will contact you if you/your child is eligible, and arrange a session at the Prince of Wales Hospital for detailed study explanation and signature of consent forms.
The team will collect blood and stool samples from participants in this study. Participants will receive HK$100 food voucher, a blood test report, and a gut microbiome report after completion of the study.
The team will contact eligible participants within one month of receiving your form submission. You have not been selected to participate in the study if the team has not contacted you in a month.
All information collected will be used for contact purposes only and will only be accessible to authorised personnel. Should you/your child have any questions regarding form submission or study details, please call 9671 1756 within office hours.
Registration form link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3yNko4UyWrBHCJg
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Student Helper Wanted for Social Science & Public Health Research   有薪兼職｜彈性工時｜累積研究經驗｜研究助理招募 - Department of Medicine and Therapeutics
From: Michelle Kwan
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
michellekwan@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
We are looking for a
Year 3 or above undergraduate student or postgraduate student
to join our research team and assist with a
scoping review
related to community services for older adults.
This is an excellent opportunity for students interested in
social science, public health, ageing, community services, and research methods
to gain hands-on research experience while earning extra income.
Job Responsibilities
Conduct literature searches and support the scoping review process
Assist with screening and organizing research articles
Support the project team with simple coordination and liaison tasks
Assist with data extraction and summarization of findings
What We Offer
Flexible working hours that can be arranged around your study schedule
Opportunity to gain research experience in social science and public health research
Exposure to academic publication and evidence synthesis processes
Hourly-paid position (≥65HKD/hour)
Requirements
Current Year 3 or above undergraduate student, or postgraduate student
Background in Social Sciences, Public Health, Sociology, Psychology, Social Work, Gerontology, or related disciplines
Strong English reading and writing skills
Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work independently
Prior experience in literature reviews, academic research, or qualitative research is an advantage
Students with a social science background will be given priority consideration
Application
If you are interested in this position and would like to contribute to research on healthy ageing and community services, please complete the recruitment form below:
https://forms.gle/oTfV8WRV7hhj6fEa6
Application Deadline:
4 September 2026 (Friday)

Announcements
Male Mandarin Native Speakers: Language Processing Lab Study  【男性普通话母语者招募中】你的大脑是怎么读中文的？来实验室告诉我们 - Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
From: Yiting WANG
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yitingwang@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你好！
想不想知道你的大脑如何读中文？
我们正在招募
男性普通话母语者
参与脑电实验，任务很简单：
来实验室看一些中文句子
。我们会记录你的脑电波，看看母语阅读时大脑有多忙碌！
本实验室使用临床级安全的脑电图系统，收集人自身产生的微弱生物电并绘制成波形图，不会对人体产生伤害。有任何安全顾虑都可以和研究人员联系了解：Miss WANG, yitingwang@cuhk.edu.hk
实验时长
：约1.5小时
实验内容：
1）佩戴脑电设备，参加互动实验，阅读一些汉语句子并用键盘按键做出反应；2）填写一些问卷。
实验地点：
中文大学梁銶琚楼G层（语言学系）G34实验室。
实验结束后，会通过转数快支付
120
港元
被试费用。
参与者需要符合以下要求
：
1.
男性
，
18-25岁
，来自中国大陆，母语为汉语普通话；
2. 视力（矫正后）正常，无干涩等眼部不适；
3. 听力正常；
4. 无脑损伤、癫痫等神经类疾病，无头皮外伤或感染；
5. 无身体残疾；
6. 近2个月内无染发，实验当天不化妆，实验当天在家自行洗头；
7. 可以接受在头发头皮上涂抹特质的导电膏体（实验室配备专门的洗头房，供您实验结束之后洗净吹干）；
8. 非心理学、语言学专业；
9. 右利手（写字、用筷子等习惯使用右手）；
10. 没有参加过此实验的相关实验（如果不确定可以联系主试确认：Miss WANG, yitingwang@cuhk.edu.hk)
报名链接
：https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_7PsFSB4SG9yxfN4
香港中文大学语言学及现代语言系
This research is endorsed by
Prof. CAI Zhenguang
zhenguangcai@cuhk.edu.hk
Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Hi there!
Ever wondered how does your brain read Chinese?
We’re recruiting
native Mandarin speakers
for an EEG experiment. The task is simple:
come to the lab and read some Chinese sentences
(silently—no reading aloud!). We’ll record your brainwaves to see how busy your brain gets when processing your native language.
Duration of the experiment
: The experiment duration is approximately 1.5 hours
Experiment content:
1) wearing EEG devices, reading some Chinese sentences and responding with keyboard keys; 2) filling out some questionnaires.
Experiment location
: Room G34, G/F, K.K. Leung Building, The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
The subject fee of
HK$120
will be paid via FPS at the end of the experiment.
Participants need to meet the
following requirements
:
1. male native Mandarin Chinese speaker, 18-25 years old;
2. have normal vision (after correction) and no eye discomfort such as dryness;
3. have normal hearing;
4. no brain injury, epilepsy or other neurological diseases, no scalp trauma or infection;
5. no physical disability;
6. no hair coloring in the last 2 months, no make-up on the day of the experiment, and washing hair at home by themselves on the day of the experiment;
7. can accept the application of special conductive paste on the hair scalp (the laboratory is equipped with a special hair washing room; participants can wash hair at the end of the experiment);
8. non-psychology / linguistics majors;
9. right-handed (writing, using chopsticks, etc.);
10. have not participated in the preparatory experiment for this experiment. If you are not sure, you can contact the experimenter to confirm: Miss WANG, yitingwang@cuhk.edu.hk
Enrolment link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_7PsFSB4SG9yxfN4
Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
This research is endorsed by
Prof. CAI Zhenguang

The Independent Learning Centre (ILC) offers a wide range of workshops and activities to support learning of language and communication skills. Visit our website for more information: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ (20260824)  - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Weekly Highlights - English Section 】
A. Communication, Study Skills and Job Preparation Workshops
The Independent Learning Centre offers English workshops 24 August to 28 August: (1) Listening to Learn: Academic Listening and Note-taking Skills, (2) Saying What You Mean - English Pronunciation for Cantonese and Mandarin Speakers, (3) Job Preparation Series: Ace Your In-person and Video Job Interviews, (4) Study Skills in English at University Level, (5) Citation and Referencing Matters in Academic Writing, and (6) Interview Practice and Self Reflection. These workshops are now available for registration at: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in English
Consultation service is available during the following time:
24 August (Mon): 14:30 – 16:30
25 August (Tue): 14:30 – 16:30
26 August (Wed): 14:30 – 16:30
27 August (Thu): 10:30 – 12:30
28 August (Fri): 14:30 – 16:30
Online Booking:
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
More Timeslot please check our website：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EH/consultation.aspx
====================================
【Weekly Highlights - Chinese Section 】中文部本週活動
A. Chinese Workshops 中文工作坊
The Independent Learning Centre offers Chinese workshops 24 August to 28 August: (1) JRE Argumentative Writing II, (2) Academic Writing: Citation and Bibliography (PTH), and (3) Self- Learning Cantonese III. These workshops are now available for registration at: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
自學中心八月二十四日至八月二十八日舉辦 (1) 「射者正己而後發」——射藝與修身 (粵), (2) JRE 議論文寫作 (II), (3) 學術寫作：引用與文獻目錄 (普), (4) 「信而好古」——粵語與中國古代文化 (粵), 及 (5) 自學粵語 (三)等工作坊，歡迎報名。
登記連結： https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in Chinese 自學中心中文輔導服務
Consultation service is available during the following time:
自學中心於八月二十四日至八月二十八日提供以下中文輔導時段。
24 August (Mon): 10:30 – 12:30 and 14:30 – 16:30
25 August (Tue): 14:30 – 16:30
